text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Today, I—run.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I can't say anything cool like doing it for myself. But—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of everyone
who's placed their bets on me!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here we are at the Takarazuka Kinen!
This year features one of the most star-studded, top-tier lineups in history!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "First up is the Symboli specialist. Rumored to be the strongest of them all: Symboli Kris S!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Claiming the spring Grand Prix—our only directive is execution.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rapidly making a name for herself since late last year,
the seeker of romance, Tap Dance City!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Haha, let's dance! Whoever keeps dancing till the very end is the winner!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: A visitor from the Classic Year. The Unidentified Running Entity who achieved the Double Crown, Neo Universe!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
An encounter with the 'Unknown'...
How 'thrilling.'

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And the ultimate Umamusume fan! An all-rounder
who chases her faves across turf and dirt alike,
Agnes Digital!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ To think I get to run
while getting all jostled around in the pack~!

It was a stellar lineup that overwhelmed you
just by looking at it, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Shrimp, squid, scallops, snow crab...
Shrimp, squid, scallops, snow crab...
choice_data_list: Is that some kind of charm...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Rather than a good luck charm...
I just decided to look at it this way.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: She said that all of today's rivals are "ingredients for okonomiyaki."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes. It's scary to think of them as Umamusume, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: If you think of it as toppings, it looks delicious!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I want to have a taste of success too.
No, wait..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Everyone wants to taste the good life!
Even if nobody was paying attention to them at first!
That's why...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: And here comes Hishi Miracle! It's Hishi Miracle!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The conqueror of the Tenno Sho (Spring)!
Will those talents as a stayer carry over
to the dream stage of middle distance?

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Hishi Miracle...
I'm actually cheering for her today.

text_block_list.name: Other Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But can I win?
At this distance, against this lineup?

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I can't win.
Still, who's to say I shouldn't try?

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"An Umamusume who's never seen the spotlight won."
That's what they're saying...

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator
text_block_list.text: —I wanna dream, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"That's right, the dream stage...
isn't reserved for some special few."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Anyone can be the protagonist.
Even me, who lost 9 times in a row before debut.
Even someone just like me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of them wants to dream!
And to live up to those expectations!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food, loaded okonomiyaki!
